summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd., a Fujian-based amusement park operator listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an advisory agreement dated September 11, 2026 with YITONG ASIA INVESTMENT PTE. LTD., a Singapore exempt private company wholly owned by Cuizhang Gong. The advisor provides twelve months of corporate strategy, capital markets, investment and M&A advisory services for a stated US$10,000 fee, payable entirely in 6,000,000 newly issued Class B ordinary shares (par US$0.00001), delivered within seven business days, subject to a twelve-month lock-up with customary exceptions. No price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor fairness opinion is disclosed. Watch the Class B issuance's dilutive effect, voting-rights impact and potential change-of-control overhang.
